claims.content: To configure the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings on the Manage Global Settings page so the Auctioneer can define cost tiers with opening bid amounts or percentages of cost and discrete bid increments that govern items in each tier and may be overridden by Event Profiles.

goal.raw_text: To configure the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings on the Manage Global Settings page so the Auctioneer can define cost tiers with opening bid amounts or percentages of cost and discrete bid increments that govern items in each tier and may be overridden by Event Profiles.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auction Administration — Manage Global Settings interface is available.
The Manage Global Settings page has a Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings section.
The Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings section contains user-definable cost tiers.
Each cost tier has corresponding fields governing the reserve (opening bids) amount and the bid increment for all items in that cost tier.
The opening bid fields have radio button options allowing the Auctioneer to choose the field for opening bid amount or percentage of cost.
The bid increment fields allow for discrete, full dollar amounts.
The Auctioneer selects the Manage Global Settings option from the Administration Menu to configure the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer selects the Manage Global Settings option from the Administration Menu to configure the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings.

claims.content: Auctioneer selects "Manage Global Settings" from the Administration Menu.
The "Auction Administration — Manage Global Settings" interface is displayed, structured into several configuration sections.
Auctioneer uses the Reserve Tier & Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings section to define user-definable cost tiers.
For each cost tier, Auctioneer sets the corresponding fields that govern the reserve (opening bids) amount and the bid increment for all items in that cost tier.
For the opening bid fields, Auctioneer uses the radio button options to choose opening bid amount or percentage of cost.
Auctioneer sets the bid increment fields using discrete, full dollar amounts.
Auctioneer selects the "Apply Changes" button in the Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings section.
At main flow step 3, the Auctioneer may set the opening bid as a fixed Amount for some cost tiers and as a % of Cost for other cost tiers.

At main flow step 4, if the Auctioneer selects the percentage-of-cost radio button option for an opening bid field, the Auctioneer sets the opening bid as a percentage of cost rather than as a fixed opening bid amount.
At main flow step 6, after the Auctioneer selects 'Apply Changes,' the configured parameters may be overridden by Event Profiles.
The Reserve Tier and Bid Increment Sitewide Default Settings Section contains the user-definable cost tiers.
Each cost tier has corresponding fields governing the reserve (opening bids) amount and the bid increment for all items in that cost tier.
The opening bid fields have radio button options allowing the Auctioneer to choose the field for opening bid amount or percentage of cost.
The bid increment fields allow for discrete, full dollar amounts.
These parameters may be overridden by Event Profiles.
